name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.95: machine detail view reorganised into four tabs (Overview / Planogram-or-Bays / Activity / Controls) for a cleaner mobile experience. Overview leads with a quick-action grid (coil vs fridge actions, Weimi sync gated to ag_admin) plus empty slots and a new recently-sold-out panel scoped to the machine. All existing sections and their render wiring are preserved and relocated into tabs; the 2nd tab labels Planogram on fridges and Bays on coil. Adds a check_update quick action (enqueues the command added in v5.92). No backend/API change; this is a dashboard UI restructure. Cumulative over v5.94.
